ExpectedGoalieLine.description: The model's own expectation of a goalie's season: `ExpectedSkaterLine` for goalies.
ExpectedGoalieLine.title: ExpectedGoalieLine

ExpectedSkaterLine.description:
The model's own expectation of a skater's season, which the served line beside it was
lifted from: the same stats, on the expectation's own games. The better guess about one
player, and the line to compare when two of the model's lines are set side by side; a page
shows the served one.
ExpectedSkaterLine.title: ExpectedSkaterLine

LeaderboardResponse.description: The race for one stat: who is likely to win it, and with what.
LeaderboardResponse.title: LeaderboardResponse

RestOfSeasonGoalieResponse.description:
A goalie's expected line over his club's remaining games, the crease divided among the
club's goalies over what it has left.
RestOfSeasonGoalieResponse.title: RestOfSeasonGoalieResponse

RestOfSeasonSkaterResponse.description:
A skater's expected line over his club's remaining games. The season line's stats, without
its bands: there is no finishing table over this line and no band fitted for it.
RestOfSeasonSkaterResponse.title: RestOfSeasonSkaterResponse

RestOfSeasonSnapshotsResponse.description:
The days a rest-of-season line is kept for, oldest first: what `as_of` can be answered
from. Empty before the first run of a season under way has been kept.
RestOfSeasonSnapshotsResponse.title: RestOfSeasonSnapshotsResponse

ServedRestOfSeasonGoalie.description: A goalie's rest of the season as served: `ServedRestOfSeasonSkater` for goalies.
ServedRestOfSeasonGoalie.title: ServedRestOfSeasonGoalie

ServedRestOfSeasonSkater.description:
A skater's rest of the season as served: the same games as the expectation beside it, lifted
toward the table the whole season will end on at the season line's weights, his season so far
ranked with it on his expected pace and left out of it, so how the start went does not move
it. The season line's stats and its scale.
ServedRestOfSeasonSkater.title: ServedRestOfSeasonSkater

get.description:
Who is likely to lead the league, and with what.

Computed from the stored projections and their uncertainty bands rather than stored itself:
it is a view of the same rows, and a simulation nobody has to keep in step with them. It
reads each row's expectation, which is what the bands bracket; a row written before
`marcel-v88` has none and was an expectation itself.

to a constant in the client, which is how the app came to believe every season was 82 games.
